notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/6e680e3548dc28b25a266451f11463eeb8cb7c4c.png[/img]

Hello everybody,

To celebrate Halloween, I'm really pleased to announce a new update for Pictopix! 


[h1][b]Halloween[/b][/h1]

Like last year, there is a special event hidden in the game! To discover what it is, here's a little hint: go into the Workshop and play a puzzle in the Halloween theme :ishappy:

Feel free to use the search engine to find puzzles quickly!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/85182daa01c6026f22f2ef4948a35e5f7ed0ed99.png[/img]

Henceforth, this event will be active every year over the same period.

I've also created a [b]new puzzle[/b] in the Workshop. I hope you'll enjoy it!


[h1][b]Preview filling[/b][/h1]

In the new update, Pictopix introduces a new feature named "Preview filling". When this one is enabled, now you can preview the squares that you are filling. Hold the button and move the cursor to highlight squares. Then release the button to fill the squares!

A counter is also displayed next to the cursor. It shows the number of squares highlighted. It can be helpful to count them.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/8eae72425bf058b55e452b4160f9216b10be8818.gif[/img]

This feature works with the mouse, the keyboard or the controller! You can enable "Preview filling" in the game options (Gameplay tab)

Some players were asking me regularly this feature. I was reticent at first because I thought the feature will give an advantage to players in Challenges mode, but it does not. :ishappy:


[h1][b]Interface improvement[/b][/h1]

In the previous update ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=2#c1734342161852003415]version 1.3.4[/url]), I added the "Thick line" option in the Interface tab. When you check it, the five-block indicator lines are thicker (thanks constantcompile for the suggestion!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/b688976c23f18beb5e9c2037add607ce6c0190f9.gif[/img]

I also updated some skins and added two new ones ("Classic Dark" and "Amethyst") : 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/3e82cf2506209128eeacdcecf4e3c75ec35e702f.gif[/img]


[h1][b]Translation[/b][/h1]

Once again, I would like to thank the players who help me translate Pictopix in their own language. Sometimes they are not always available so there may be some missing translation. In such cases, feel free to let me know! 


As usual, you will find the full changelog [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/0/1699417068296165014/?ctp=2#c1735469327934110124]here[/url] (version 1.3.5).

Have fun and see you soon! :isveryhappy:

Tom

notes.title: Anniversary Update is live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/b201deb466853a68ef5d52ec0839c7003218f77b.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 

It is with great pleasure that I present the [b]Anniversary Update[/b]! Here's what you'll find in the new version of Pictopix:
[list]
[*] 45 new puzzles
[*] Bigger puzzles up to 40 x 40
[*] New achievements
[*] New secrets
[*] Zoom button for big grids
[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XRhzB6x_y3Y
According to my tests and calculations the time needed to solve the 45 new puzzles is longer than it was for all 155 initial puzzles! I was astonished to discover that the total playing time is more than doubled with this latest update. I therefore hope that you’ll be happy with it ːishappyː

Quite a lot of modifications and improvements have been made to the game.  To see a list of them, consult the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/3/142260895144062285/#c1620600279663693053]change log[/url] of the 1.2.0 version.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/35d012fde8281e68f1b104f248e5d8fe24d55967.png[/img]
[i]One of the new puzzles[/i]

Once again I'd like to thank the translators who have kindly translated the new puzzles. There are just one language in which the new texts have not yet been translated – Japanese. The translators are players who do this in their free time. I hope you’ll understand that they need time to complete them.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/7ed9e5129e7478c8d858aa7eefeac4baf887fd9b.png[/img]
[i]Zoomed grid[/i]

Some players have expressed the wish to play a DRM-Free version of  Pictopix on gog.com. It’s quite possible to envisage this. Even if the game will lack the Workshop, I could leave the puzzle editor in there. I will study the question before contacting gog.com.  In the meantime I suggest you show your interest in Pictopix by voting on this topic created by a player: https://www.gog.com/wishlist/games/pictopix

If you wish to be informed of the latest news about Pictopix, you can now subscribe to the newsletter: http://pictopix.tomlabgames.com/newsletter 

I wish you all a very happy New Year and all the things you could wish yourselves! ːisstarː
 
Tom

notes.title: Big update coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27228690/c3501568f5eb8a08f354e50f6aef01c66fad5060.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

[b]Pictopix[/b] will soon be celebrating its first anniversary! The 5th of January 2018 to be exact. 2017 has been a good year for Pictopix. The game has been well received by the press and by the players. Thanks to your feedback, as the months went by, I was able to improve the game. What is more, you, the players, have created more than 1,000 puzzles in the Workshop!

I'm therefore greatly excited to announce a major update coming out on the 5th of January! There'll be [b]new puzzles[/b], [b]new achievements[/b] and [b]playing time more than doubled[/b]! There'll also be some surprises.

This update will be [b]free[/b] and won't contain loot boxes! I promise!

I will put up some pictures of the update on the social networks so don't hesitate to follow Pictopix on [url=https://www.facebook.com/pictopix/]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/pictopix]Twitter[/url] for example.

While waiting for the update, keep your eye on the Workshop! With Christmas coming, I may add some puzzles! Moreover, a [b]Christmas update[/b] is available ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/568320/discussions/3/142260895144062285/#c2549465882920305820]version 1.1.20[/url]).

Wishing you a very merry Christmas and a Happy New year's! ːisstarː

See you soon!

Tom
